English: Most schools say goodbye on graduation day. We don't. This isn't a new idea we invented for marketing: students from our founder's past trainings have been practicing with him online for three, four, even five years after their course ended. We simply made into a promise what was already true.
Translation: Большинство школ прощаются в день вручения дипломов. Мы остаемся рядом.
